title: Efficient Detection of Toxic Prompts in Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus is on detecting generally toxic prompts (e.g., related to illegal activities, harmful speech, insults) to prevent harmful content generation.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on general toxic prompt detection.
